questions.prompt: When is a tuple more suitable than a general array?
options: When runtime validation should be skipped.
When positions have known types and ordering, such as a [string, number] pair.
When all elements must be unrelated values with no positional meaning.
When the values must be fetched from a database.
questions.answer_key: When positions have known types and ordering, such as a [string, number] pair.
questions.explanation: Tuples express a known sequence of positions and types.

A type assertion automatically validates every value at runtime.

questions.prompt: What is a good verification step after practicing “Tuple Type Programming”?

Ignore compiler or test failures if the interface looks correct.
Treat passing a static token check as proof that the program executed correctly.
Check variadic tuple types, include a meaningful failure case where appropriate, and document any runtime or version assumptions.
